sn36.7:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Vesaliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kuṭāgārasālāyaṃ || || 2
sn36.7:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yena gilānasālā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi ||
sn36.7:2.1: sato bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno kālam āgameyya ||
sn36.7:3.1: Kathaṃ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu sato hoti || ||
sn36.7:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyyaloke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn36.7:3.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyyaloke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn36.7:3.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sato hoti || || 4
sn36.7:4.1: Kathaṃ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno hoti || ||
sn36.7:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti || ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti || sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti || saṅghāti-pattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti || asite pite khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti || uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti || gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti || ||
sn36.7:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno hoti || || 5
sn36.7:4.4: Sato bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno kālam āgameyya
sn36.7:5.1: Tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃ satassa sampajānassa appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati sukhā vedanā || so evam pajānāti ||
sn36.7:5.2: Uppannā kho me ayaṃ sukhā vedanā ||
sn36.7:5.3: sā ca kho paṭicca no apaṭicca ||
sn36.7:5.6: ayaṃ kho pana kāyo anicco saṅkhato paṭicca samuppanno ||
sn36.7:5.7: aniccaṃ kho pana saṅkhatam paṭicca samuppannam kāyam paṭicca uppannā sukhā vedanā kuto niccā bhavissatīti || ||
sn36.7:5.8: So kāye ca sukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassī viharati || vayānupassī viharati || virāgānupassī viharati || nirodhānupassī viharati || paṭinissaggānupassī viharati ||
sn36.7:5.9: tassa kāye ca sukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassino viharato vayānupassino viharato virāgānupassino viharato nirodhānupassino viharato paṭinissaggānupassino viharato yo kāye ca sukhāya ca vedanāya rāgānusayo so pahīyati || || 7
sn36.7:6.1: Tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃ satassa sampajānassa appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati dukkhā vedanā ||
sn36.7:6.4: sā ca kho paṭicca || no apaṭicca ||
sn36.7:6.7: ayaṃ kho pana kāyo anicco saṅkhato paṭicca samuppanno ||
sn36.7:6.8: Aniccaṃ kho pana saṅkhataṃ paṭicca samuppannam kāyam paticca uppannā dukkhā vedanā kuto niccā bhavissatīti || ||
sn36.7:6.9: So kaye ca dukkhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassī viharati || vayānupassī viharati || virāgānupassī viharati || nirodhānupassī viharati || paṭinissaggānupassī viharati || paṭinissaggānupassī viharati ||
sn36.7:6.10: tassa kāye ca dukkhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassino viharato || la || paṭinissaggānupassino viharato yo kāye ca dukkhāya ca vedanāya paṭighānusayo so pahīyati || || 8
sn36.7:7.1: Tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃ satassa sampajānassa appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā so evam pajānāti || ||
sn36.7:7.3: sā ca kho paṭicca no appaṭicca
sn36.7:7.6: ayaṃ kho pana kāyo anicco saṅkhato paṭicca samuppanno ||
sn36.7:7.7: aniccaṃ kho pana saṅkhataṃ paṭicca samuppannaṃ kāyam paṭicca uppannā adukkhamasukhā vedanā kuto niccā bhavissatīti || ||
sn36.7:7.8: So kāye ca adukkhamasukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassī viharati || vayānupassī || pe || virāgānupassī || nirodhānupassī || paṭinissaggānupassī viharati ||
sn36.7:7.9: tassa kāye ca adukkhamasukhāya ca vedanāya ca aniccānupassino viharato || la || paṭinissaggānupassino viharato yo kaye ca adukkhamasukhāya ca vedanāya avijjānusayo so pahīyati || || 9
sn36.7:8.1: So sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati Sā aniccāti pajānāti || Anajjhositā ti pajānāti || Anabhinanditā ti pajānāti || ||
sn36.7:8.3: Adukkhamasukhaṃ ce vedanam vediyati Sā aniccāti pajānāti || Anajjhositā ti pajānāti || Anabhinanditā ti pajānāti || || 10
sn36.7:8.4: So sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati || || Dukkhaṃ
sn36.7:8.5: ce vedanaṃ vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati || adukkhamasukhaṃ
sn36.7:8.6: ce vedanaṃ vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati || || 11
sn36.7:8.7: So kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno Kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti || jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno Jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti ||
sn36.7:8.8: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā Idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantīti pajānāti || || 12
sn36.7:9.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhu telaṃ ca paṭicca vaṭṭiṃ ca telapadīpo jhāyeyya ||
sn36.7:9.2: tasseva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā anāhāro nibbāyeyya || ||
sn36.7:9.3: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno Kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti || Jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno Jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti ||
sn36.7:9.4: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā Idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantīti pajānātīti || || 1
